create_PanopticEvaluator: create a PanopticEvaluator instance with annotation file, annotation folder, and output directory for panoptic evaluation
update_PanopticEvaluator_predictions: update the PanopticEvaluator with new predictions by writing PNG strings to disk and accumulating results
synchronize_PanopticEvaluator_processes: synchronize predictions across all distributed processes by gathering and merging prediction lists
summarize_PanopticEvaluator_results: summarize panoptic evaluation results by writing predictions to JSON and computing PQ metrics via pq_compute
run_PanopticEvaluator_full_pipeline: run the full panoptic evaluation pipeline by initializing evaluator, updating predictions, synchronizing, and summarizing results
